title: Garlicky Sautéed Spinach
description: A mountain of spinach wilted in minutes with olive oil, sliced garlic and a pinch of chili, finished with lemon.

image.alt: A skillet of wilted spinach with sliced garlic and lemon

steps.text: Warm the oil, garlic and pepper flakes in the pot over medium heat until the garlic is pale golden, {time 2 min}.
Add the spinach a big handful at a time with the salt, turning with tongs as it wilts, {time 3-4 min} in all.
Tip off any liquid in the pot, toss with the lemon juice and serve right away.

notes: Spinach shrinks to about a tenth of its raw volume; this big pile makes four modest servings.
